why_failed: the frozen check_schur_lower.py implements the STANDARD Schur condition (x=y allowed, i.e. it rejects any monochromatic doubling x+x=2x). The weak Schur number WS(6) is defined by the WEAK condition (x<y<z strict, doublings allowed). These are different forbidden-pattern sets, and the weak Schur numbers are provably >= the standard ones because the weak constraint is strictly looser. Demonstrated concretely: colouring=[0,0] (r=1,n=2) is a valid weak-Schur witness for the known exact value WS(1)=2, but the frozen checker REJECTs it (monochromatic 1+1=2). No amount of search against this checker can produce a certified weak-Schur result; the checker would have to be extended (out of write-scope: mine/verify/ is frozen) or a separate weak-Schur checker built and frozen through the proper pipeline stage. No search was run against the n=646 target for this reason.
cost: 0 (single checker invocation, <1s, to produce the demonstration)
